ideas.name: any warning with VIX above VXV
ideas.why: an inverted volatility curve (1-month over 3-month) is a stressed market: forced selling and short covering overshoot both ways, and turns pay

ideas.name: any warning with VXN's premium over VIX above its 60-day median
ideas.why: Nasdaq volatility unusually far above the S&P's means stress is in tech itself; MNQ swings wider than the index flow and comes back (against its median: in 2026 Jul-Oct the ratio never fell under 1.25)

ideas.name: any warning after yesterday's range broke today
ideas.why: once today has traded beyond yesterday's high or low, the day is discovering new prices, and turns get run over

ideas.name: any warning on a 5m inside bar
ideas.why: the last closed 5m bar inside the one before: the slower chart pausing, the 1m inside bar's near-pass at a scale with fewer, cleaner pauses

ideas.name: 1m warning with a 15m row warning the same way
ideas.why: the 15m box already easing toward the same turn: the slow chart's momentum fading under the fast one
